title: Grab Bar 60-Inch Extended 3-Post ADA Compliant | Pipeline Grab Bars | Allied Brass
short_title: Pipeline Extended 3 Post Grab Bar - 60 Inch
description:
Create a safer, more accessible bathroom with an extended-length grab bar that provides steady support where you need it most.

Highlights:
- Gain added stability along a longer span with an extended 60-inch grab bar design
- Feel secure with a 3-post configuration that adds a third center bracket for stability
- Coordinate your space easily with the Pipeline look, designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware
- Choose a finish that suits your bathroom décor with multiple designer finish options available
- Ideal for everyday support in the shower, tub area, or along the bathroom wall for caregivers, seniors, and accessible design

- Product type: Extended 3-post bathroom grab bar
- Collection: Pipeline / grab bars collection
- Length: 60-Inch (overall product dimensions: 63 in. L x 3 in. H x 3.58 in. W)
- Compliance: ADA Compliant
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

_previous.title: Pipeline Extended 3 Post Grab Bar - 60 inch
_previous.description: Make your bathroom a safer and more accessible space with the extended length 3 post grab bar from the Allied Brass Pipeline Collection. Designed with the needs of seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers in mind, this grab bar provides balance, security, and ease of use. The industrial look of the Pipeline collection adds a modern touch to any bathroom decor, while the lifetime materials ensure a clean, decorative finish that lasts for years. With superior materials that are free from corrosion and rust, this grab bar is a reliable and stylish addition to your bathroom. Trust Allied Brass to provide high-quality bathroom fittings that enhance your safety and comfort. Contemporary pipe design with industrial influences ADA Compliant Bars feature a third center bracket to ensure stability Protected using highly durable powder coat finish Designer finish will provide Corrosion-free and rust-free performance Provided with a limited lifetime warranty Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in.
